title: LayoutPlan
description: Agent 2 intermediate artifact. A STRUCTURAL, non-geometric layout plan that sits between the architecture model and the geometry engines. It interprets the semantic policy intent (strategy + lane/layer/column ordering + emphasis) and the architecture topology into ordered bands and a node->band assignment. It contains NO coordinates, sizes, or routes - geometry remains the sole responsibility of the layout engines. Produced deterministically today; an optional LLM planner may emit the same shape later. Shared abstraction consumed by the geometry patterns.

strategy.description: The resolved layout strategy id, e.g. 'multi_az_columns', 'ordered_lanes', 'banded_tiers', 'column_compare', 'grouped_grid', 'central_hub', 'generic_stack'.

bandKind.description: The organizing primitive the strategy uses. 'lane'/'layer'/'column' = ordered 1-D bands (horizontal flow, vertical tiers, side-by-side columns). 'group' = labeled, unordered grouping boxes. 'hub' = a central element with peripheral members. 'containment' = nested containers come straight from the topology (e.g. multi-AZ VPC/AZ/subnet). 'none' = generic fall-through, bands are advisory only.

bands.description: Ordered bands. Index order IS the visual order (left-to-right for lane/column, top-to-bottom for layer). For 'group'/'hub'/'containment' order is non-binding.

bandId.description: Stable band id, typically the hint token (e.g. 'sources', 'application_services', 'current') or a derived container id.

order.description: 0-based visual order within the band set.

role.description: Optional semantic role, e.g. subnet tier 'public'|'compute'|'data', or 'hub'|'spoke'.

assignments.description: One entry per assigned architecture node, mapping it to a band. A node assigned to no band is reported in diagnostics (unassigned), not silently dropped.

nodeId.description: Architecture node id (identical to the id the engine/compiler uses).

bandId.description: The band this node belongs to (must match a bands[].bandId).

rank.description: Optional intra-band ordering hint (lower first). Advisory; the engine may refine.

emphasis.description: Carried-through emphasis aspects from the policy (e.g. 'ingress','trust_boundaries'). Advisory styling/grouping intent for the engine.

orderingSource.description: Where the band ordering came from: an explicit policy hint (laneOrder/layerOrder/columns), the architecture topology (containment), or a documented default.

diagnostics.description: Human-readable notes: how bands/ordering were derived, unassigned nodes, unknown hint tokens, fallbacks. Never silent.
